dct_description_sm: These datasets provide the delimitation of highways, feeder and farm roads in Bhutan. The road dataset was created in 2008 by the GoB National Land Commission and obtained from the [Bhutan Geospatial Portal](http://www.geo.gov.bt/) in May 2015 and includes road surface information and road names where known. This dataset can be complemented by the OSM dataset that includes several additional roads in the north east.
dct_publisher_sm: Government of Bhutan - National Land Commission; Open Street Map
